<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/api/logs/reveal"}

Returns the unmasked `message_summary` of each given log record, for a caller with the 'Unredact PHI' (logs.unredact) permission (403 otherwise) - the summaries `GET /api/logs` sends masked. Records that don't exist, or belong to a project the caller isn't on, are left out. Sending a message's summary unmasked is recorded in the audit trail.
